### Props

| Name                 | Type                 | Required | Default                                               | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| -------------------- | -------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `title`              | `string`             |          | `() =&gt; t('nextcloud-vue', 'Location')`             | Widget title shown in the header.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `objectData`         | `object`             |          | `\{\}`                                                | The object data — its `@self.geo` seeds the marker; `@self` also supplies register/schema/id fallbacks.                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `objectId`           | `string&#124;number` |          | `''`                                                  | The object's id. Explicit prop wins over `objectData['@self'].id`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `register`           | `string&#124;number` |          | `''`                                                  | OpenRegister register slug/id. When omitted, derived from `objectData['@self'].register`.                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `schema`             | `string&#124;number` |          | `''`                                                  | OpenRegister schema slug/id. When omitted, derived from `objectData['@self'].schema`.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `editable`           | `boolean`            |          | `true`                                                | Whether the map is editable (click to set, footer Save/Remove). Read-only when false.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `height`             | `string&#124;number` |          | `'360px'`                                             | Map container height. Forwarded to CnMapWidget.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `defaultCenter`      | `array`              |          | `[...DEFAULT_CENTER]`                                 | Map centre `[lat, lng]` used when the object has no location yet.                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `defaultZoom`        | `number`             |          | `7`                                                   | Zoom used when the object has no location yet.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `layers`             | `Array<object>`      |          | `() =&gt; DEFAULT_LAYERS.map((l) =&gt; (\{ ...l \}))` | Base layer stack forwarded to `CnMapWidget` (`{ type, url, options }[]`). Defaults to the OpenStreetMap standard tile set; override to use a different basemap (e.g. the Dutch PDOK BRT achtergrondkaart). Supplying a `tile` entry here takes over the background and disables `basemap`. |
| `basemap`            | `string`             |          | `'standard'`                                          | Base map shown by default — one of `standard`, `humanitarian`, `terrain`. The app must allowlist the tile host in its `img-src` CSP.                                                                                                                                                       |
| `allowBasemapSwitch` | `boolean`            |          | `false`                                               | Offer a base-map switcher so users can change the background themselves.                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `fitControl`         | `boolean`            |          | `true`                                                | Show the "fit to location" control (re-centres on the marker).                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `locateControl`      | `boolean`            |          | `true`                                                | Show the "locate me" control (browser geolocation).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `fullscreenControl`  | `boolean`            |          | `true`                                                | Show the fullscreen toggle.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `addressSearch`      | `boolean`            |          | `false`                                               | Show an address-search box that geocodes a place name via OpenStreetMap Nominatim and drops the marker there. Requires `editable`, and the app must allowlist `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org` in its `connect-src` CSP.                                                              |
| `documentationUrl`   | `string`             |          | `''`                                                  | Documentation link for the overflow Actions menu.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `widgetId`           | `string`             |          | `''`                                                  | Stable id forwarded to the widget chrome.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
